text_block_list.text:
One day, per Голд Сити's request, we
train right
up until sunset.
Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Thud!
Hm? What was that?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Yukino? What are you doing?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Ah, um... W-well...
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Hey, calm down.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What are all those plastic bottles on the
ground?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Um, ah, it's refresh'n water from
Morioka!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I was plannin' on bring'n 'em to you, but
then...
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
When I saw you look'n so beautiful in
the sunset...
I was mesmerized.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Beautiful, huh? It always comes down to
that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Pard'n me?
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
It's nothing. Was just thinking how I
couldn't
change the words people use to
describe me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Just once, I wanted them to call me a
"strong"
runner.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Well, not that I care about that
anymore. Now, I
run because I want to.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You don't understand, do you?!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's true that you're super beautiful on
the
outside... so beautiful it hurts, even.
But that's not
all I mean!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Everythin's packed into that word. When we say "beautiful," we mean "strong," and "awesome," and all of that stuff!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: You, right now, are incredibly beautiful.
You, right now, are incredibly beautiful.

If you really think all we're seein' is your
looks,
that just... it makes me so sad.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: 'Cause everythin' about you's beautiful.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: You... really think so?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Then... back then...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're so pretty when you run!
City, you're
the best!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe a model can run like that!
You're so
cool, City!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Are you saying...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Some of those people... were seeing me as a runner?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...City?
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: AHAHA!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So... what, it was all in my head? God,
I'm such an
idiot.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Like, seriously. I'm a board-certified
idiot... Haha!
HAHAHA!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...You're beautiful.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You've always been beautiful, but... you
look ev'n
more beautiful now.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I like it. You're the best you've ev'r
been!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
I get that. Because you know what?
Right now, I
like myself too!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
